prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: LinkedIn Lead Generation Monthly Job | Hiring!
This is the job requirements: i) Sending around 150 LinkedIn Connection Request per week. ii) Sending DM's to Accepted Connection Request. iii) Following Up with the Prospect. *Your main goal is to make them book a discovery call with us. We generate 60 discovery calls every month with the same number of Connection Request (150/week) GOAL: Book at least 70 Discovery Calls. You'll be provided complete guidance on how to perform each and every step. We'll guide you on who to target, we'll provide the exact outreach scripts, etc. The job will require around 2~3 hours per day (you're free to work for others in your free time) Salary is negotiable and is performance based. ₹20,000 / month (if 70 discovery calls booked) ₹25,000 / month (if 90 discovery calls booked) ₹30,000 / month (if 100+ discovery calls booked) *If you can meet our monthly goals - we'll be keeping you for long term, as we're looking for a permanent LinkedIn Outreach VA. Thanks
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need someone who can consistently send LinkedIn connection requests, follow up with accepted leads, and turn outreach into booked discovery calls.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience working with data-driven workflows, structured communication, and machine learning tools like Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and NLP. I’m comfortable following exact outreach processes, staying organized with daily volume, and keeping track of leads and follow-ups carefully.

Your targets are clear, and I like working with defined goals and performance-based expectations. I can follow your guidance closely, maintain consistent outreach activity, and focus on the main outcome: booked discovery calls.

I’d be glad to help you hit and exceed your monthly booking goals and support this as a long-term role.
